newsitem.title: NORWAY: Elkem restarts Rana ferrochrome plant.
newsitem.headline: Elkem restarts Rana ferrochrome plant.

text.p: Norwegian metals producer Elkem ASA said on Friday it had begun to restart ferrochrome production at the Rana complex in northern Norway, which had been completely shut down since October 1.
The company shut in a 75,000 tonne per year furnace on September 1 because of weak market fundamentals and scheduled maintenance.
It closed a second unit at the 160,000 tonne per year plant on October 1.

"We restarted one furnace on Thursday and we plan to restart the second on December 17," said Elkem spokesman Ola Boesterud. "We will be back on full production at both furnaces a little before January 1."
Elkem's Rana complex supplies ferrochrome, an important element in stainless steel production, to the European market.
Boesterud said previously high stock levels of ferrochrome had been reduced since the shutdown.
"We had too high stocks, which have been brought down and now we are restarting production to meet our obligations to our customers," he said.
